novel_features.name: Research session stitch
novel_features.description: Bind search, extract, and task/findall runs into one local session chain for agent resume.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible with a local multi-entity session graph joining Product call IDs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to resume a multi-step Parallel research loop without re-fetching.

novel_features.name: Balance-aware run cost guard
novel_features.description: Refuse Task creates when prepaid balance is below a threshold.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining Account OAuth balance with Product task intent in one CLI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before expensive Task Groups when you must avoid surprise credit burn.

novel_features.name: Stale monitor event digest
novel_features.description: Mechanical per-monitor event counts and top titles since a duration window.
novel_features.rationale: Needs local monitor_events aggregation no single list-events call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for Monday triage of which monitors fired or went quiet.

novel_features.name: Cross-run research recall
novel_features.description: FTS across local searches, extracts, and task summaries with typed hit IDs.
novel_features.rationale: Requires multi-table FTS over a local research store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before paying for a live search when prior local research may already answer.

novel_features.name: FindAll to Task Group promote
novel_features.description: Turn FindAll candidates into a Task Group enrichment job.
novel_features.rationale: Composes local FindAll cache with Product Task Group create in one command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when entity discovery should immediately become batch enrichment.

novel_features.name: Prepaid burn vs runs
novel_features.description: Diff local balance snapshots against local run volume over a window.
novel_features.rationale: Needs historical balance_snapshots joined to local run tables.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when explaining weekly credit burn without opening the dashboard.

novel_features.name: Task interaction lineage
novel_features.description: Print the offline previous_interaction_id follow-up chain for a run.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local interaction graph accumulated across Task creates.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when debugging multi-turn deep research context chains offline.

narrative.headline: Agent-native Parallel web research with a local SQLite memory no other Parallel CLI keeps.
narrative.value_prop: Search, extract, deep research, FindAll, monitors, and Account balance/apps/keys in one Go binary. Session stitch, research recall, and monitor digests compound every run into offline memory. Product API key auth stays separate from Account OAuth so headline search never requires a dashboard login.
narrative.auth_narrative: Product commands use PARALLEL_API_KEY via the x-api-key header. Account commands (balance, apps, keys) need an OAuth device-flow Bearer JWT (see docs.parallel.ai/integrations/account-api); a Product API key alone cannot call Account endpoints. Never commit API key values.

quickstart.comment: Verify binary health without spending credits

quickstart.command: parallel-pp-cli research recall "Parallel Web Systems" --json --agent --select hits.source,hits.id,hits.title
quickstart.comment: Recall prior local research before another paid call

troubleshoots.symptom: Account balance returns 401 with API key
troubleshoots.fix: Obtain an OAuth device-flow Bearer JWT for Account API; Product PARALLEL_API_KEY cannot call balance
Obtain an OAuth device-flow Bearer JWT for Account API; Product PARALLEL_API_KEY cannot call balance
Back off; Search defaults to 600 POST/min — prefer turbo mode and local research recall

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for agent-native Parallel web research loops, offline recall of past searches/runs, FindAll-to-enrichment pipelines, monitor digests, and dual-auth Account admin. Prefer official parallel-cli when you need its YAML enrich planner or DuckDB/BigQuery deploy integrations.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI as a general web browser or scraper outside Parallel APIs
Do not use Account balance add for large unattended spends without reviewing idempotency keys
Do not prefer this over Parallel Search MCP for one-off free anonymous search experiments
